## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting user behavior. Link a related issue when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and relevant results. For terminal input or layout changes,
include the PTY smoke test. Call out untested platforms or checks.

## Compatibility

Describe command, JSON, Git-version, Rust-version, or release/install changes.
Explain any change to discovery coverage, cleanup protections, or terminal restoration.
